answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when independent audits confirm coordinated identities claiming separate rewards. Auditors sample task histories and compare shared funding, timing, and repeated behavior; a beacon can randomly select cases, making it harder to game the checks. Genuine agents recover their stake, but an attacker must lock capital in every fake account and risks losing it, so multiplying identities becomes costly. A harbor may welcome a sonnet-writing agent, but not a free fleet of clones.
